entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: The royalty-free open standard for 3D graphics on the Web.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the X3D standard, heavily integrating HTML5.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D Consortium working group focused on medical and molecular visualization.

entities.name: CAD Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D Consortium working group dedicated to Computer-Aided Design and Product Lifecycle Management.

entities.name: Geospatial Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D Consortium working group focused on geographic information systems and digital twins.

entities.name: Cultural Heritage Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D Consortium working group focused on preserving and displaying cultural heritage artifacts.

entities.name: Design Printing and Scanning Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D Consortium working group focused on 3D printing and scanning workflows.

entities.name: Medical Component
entities.note: An X3D component that provides support for medical records and visualization.

entities.name: CADGeometry Component
entities.note: An X3D component that defines nodes for CAD assemblies and parts.

entities.name: Geospatial Component
entities.note: An X3D component that provides support for geographic coordinates and geospatial rendering.

entities.name: DIS Component
entities.note: An X3D component providing Distributed Interactive Simulation networking capabilities.

entities.name: VolumeRendering Component
entities.note: An X3D component used extensively in medical imaging to render 3D volumetric data.

entities.name: GeoLocation
entities.note: An X3D node that specifies a geographic coordinate reference frame.

entities.name: CADAssembly
entities.note: An X3D node that groups CAD parts into a single assembly.

entities.name: CADPart
entities.note: An X3D node representing an individual CAD part.

entities.name: EspduTransform
entities.note: An X3D node that handles Entity State Protocol Data Units for DIS.

entities.name: DISEntityManager
entities.note: An X3D node that manages multiple DIS entities in a simulation.

entities.name: IsoSurfaceVolumeData
entities.note: An X3D node that extracts and renders an isosurface from volumetric data.

entities.name: Distributed Interactive Simulation
entities.note: A network protocol for real-time interactive simulation.

entities.name: IEEE 1278
entities.note: The IEEE standard defining the Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) protocol.

entities.name: OGC
entities.note: The Open Geospatial Consortium, which collaborates with Web3D on geospatial standards.

entities.name: HL7
entities.note: Health Level Seven International, an organization developing healthcare standards.

entities.name: DICOM
entities.note: Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine standard, often visualized using X3D volume rendering.

entities.name: NIH 3D Print Exchange
entities.note: A repository by the National Institutes of Health that uses X3D for medical 3D printing models.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: A key academic institution driving X3D simulation and DIS capabilities.

entities.name: Virginia Tech
entities.note: An academic institution active in X3D medical and volume rendering research.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: A research institute heavily involved in X3DOM and cultural heritage visualization.

entities.name: Web3D Korea
entities.note: A regional chapter of the Web3D Consortium active in medical and CAD standards.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A prominent Web3D Consortium leader and advocate for X3D simulation at NPS.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: A Web3D Consortium leader specializing in medical visualization and volume rendering.

entities.name: Vince Marchetti
entities.note: A key contributor to the X3D CAD Working Group.

entities.name: Kwan-Hee Yoo
entities.note: A key researcher involved in Web3D Korea and the Medical Working Group.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript framework for integrating X3D into HTML5.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D engine that natively supports X3D.

entities.name: 3D Portrayal Service
entities.note: An OGC standard for web-based 3D portrayal that utilizes X3D.

entities.name: X3D for Web Authors
entities.note: A comprehensive textbook on X3D authored by Don Brutzman and Leonard Daly.

entities.name: Savage
entities.note: Scenario Authoring and Visualization for Advanced Graphical Environments, an NPS repository.

entities.name: Web3D Conference
entities.note: The annual ACM conference dedicated to Web3D technologies and applications.
